findings: Identidad/version: である体; SHA-256 de articleMarkdown 1950e6441898e553b2ccce334a0fb87d5f0546ff51f716c040dfeb84a302ad42; la fila wiki_articles y generatedAt 2026-09-19T21:28:15.646Z coinciden con el JSON canónico local. La coincidencia confirma identidad, no exactitud semántica.
である体 as a global plain written style and the claim that it is not just substituting である for です need style-guide or corpus evidence; none was obtained.
The distribution of である with nouns/な-adjectives and plain predicates with verbs is a grammar/style claim that needs exact source examples.

Claims about academic papers, essays, reports, press and the possibility of academic です・ます style require genre-sensitive evidence; “objective/compact” should remain attributed as tendency, not inherent meaning.
Example sentence and Spanish translations were not traced to corpus.
